key_decisions.decision: Retains passage-through-fire wording with sacrificial meaning explained; keeps distinct forbidden practices.

Keeps hooks, bronze restraints, and Babylon despite Assyrian captors.

Preserves decisive contrast and emphatic personal responsibility.
